description: This Java source file defines the class 'ModifyThingStrategy', which implements command handling logic for modifying 'Thing' entities within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages different API version schemas, handles access control logic, and applies modifications to 'Thing' objects.

classes.name: ModifyThingStrategy
classes.description: Implements the command strategy for handling 'ModifyThing' commands, including version compatibility, ACL handling, and merging modifications into existing 'Thing' entities.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Main entry point for applying a 'ModifyThing' command, delegates to version-specific handlers.

methods.name: handleModifyExistingWithV1Command
methods.description: Handles modification logic for API v1 schema.

methods.name: handleModifyExistingV1WithV1Command
methods.description: Handles modification for API v1 commands targeting schema v1.

methods.name: handleModifyExistingV2WithV1Command
methods.description: Handles modification for API v2 commands targeting schema v1.

methods.name: handleModifyExistingV2WithV2Command
methods.description: Handles modification for API v2 commands targeting schema v2.

methods.name: applyModifyCommand
methods.description: Applies the modification to the existing 'Thing', merging attributes and generating events.

methods.name: mergeThingModifications
methods.description: Merges modifications into an existing 'Thing' object, updating relevant fields.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Handles unsupported modification attempts, returning an error.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the entity tag for the previous 'Thing' entity, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the entity tag for the new 'Thing' after modification.
